content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: Generics and traits let code express reusable behavior with compile-time type checking. Rust can use static dispatch for generic parameters or dynamic dispatch through trait objects.

content_blocks.title: A reliable way to reason about it

Work through a minimal example first; then deliberately test one edge case. Traits describe behavior; generic bounds constrain acceptable types. Use dyn trait objects only when dynamic dispatch or heterogeneous collections are useful.
